snippet.title: Princess Libby's Music Journey - Libii
snippet.description:
In the North Empire, the Annual Death-themed Concert is just around the corner. 
Prince Miguel is now sending out the invitations. 🎵

🎵Libby and her friends are all invited to attend this big event!
Excited and curious, they arrive at the concert.
Oops, they don't have guitars yet. 
But don't worry, the Prince has got everything. 
🎸Everyone can make a guitar of their own in the design studio. 
Yippie~ now, it's time for fun! 💃

Download Here↓↓↓
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.libii.libbycoco
